notes: User-reported: wrong data. A Costco GAS BAR transaction record, photographed sideways - the paper runs left to right while its text reads bottom to top, and the photo carries no EXIF rotation to say so. The category trap is the point: 'costco' is a Shopping keyword, and the classifier only fell through to the structural gas signals ('Pump #', 'Litres', 'Unleaded', 'Price/Litre') when keyword scoring scored nothing, so a fill-up landed in Shopping. No 'Total' label anywhere - the amount is carried by 'Fuel Sale', 'Amount' and 'Amount due'. HST 5.81 is included in the 50.46 rather than added to it; the subtotal is therefore the net of tax, derived rather than printed, matching the reading 18-vat-inclusive-pound-sterling settles on.
